description: Samsung is expected to retain the digitiser-based S Pen technology in the Galaxy S27 Ultra, reversing earlier plans to remove it for a slimmer design. According to a recent report, the company explored alternatives like AES and hybrid stylus systems but decided to continue with EMR-based input. The move ensures battery-free S Pen support. The decision follows weak consumer response to thinner smartphones and reflects a focus on features over design. Future changes may depend on compatibility with magnetic technologies like MagSafe and Qi 2.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Will Reportedly Retain S Pen Support With Digitiser

description: Anthropic introduced a new artificial intelligence (AI) feature for Claude on Monday. Part of the AI platform’s Computer Use capability, the feature allows the chatbot to control the user’s PC and complete tasks autonomously. The capability is currently available as a research preview and can be accessed via its Claude Code or Claude Cowork function.
title: Anthropic’s Claude Can Now Use Your Computer to Complete Tasks

description: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) is reportedly testing the integration of its caller name presentation (CNAP) service with private telecom operators. A nationwide rollout is expected in the near future. The CNAP, rolled out by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India, allows users to see the names of unknown callers directly on their phones without needing a subscription or third-party apps like Truecaller.
title: BSNL Reportedly Begins CNAP Integration; Nationwide Caller ID Rollout Expected Soon

description: South Korean video game developer Pearl Abyss has released a major update for its open-world action-adventure title Crimson Desert. The post-launch update addresses several complaints highlighted by players during the game’s initial launch period. It focuses on refining the combat experience for its protagonist, Kliff, alongside other quality-of-life improvements. The deployment of these fixes is reported to have contributed to a rise in positive reviews for the game on Steam.
title: Crimson Desert Patch Fixes Performance, Combat Issues as Steam Ratings Turn ‘Mostly Positive’

description: Realme 16 5G will be equipped with a 7,000mAh battery, the Chinese smartphone maker revealed on Tuesday. The dedicated microsite for the handset has been updated to reveal that it will also support 60W wired fast charging. The company claims that the phone will offer about 22.06 hours of video playback on YouTube or up to 22.86 hours of scrolling Reels on Instagram on a single charge. The handset will also be equipped with a 6.57-inch display, offering up to 4,200 nits peak brightness, 3,000Hz of “instantaneous” touch sampling rate, and 1.07 billion colours.
title: Realme 16 5G Battery Capacity, Colourways and Other Key Features Revealed Ahead of Launch in India

description: Several laser printers with built-in scanners are available in India across different price ranges. Models from HP, Canon, and Brother offer print speeds of up to 30 to 33 pages per minute, along with duplex printing support. Most options include colour scanning, while connectivity varies between Wi-Fi-enabled and USB-only setups. With duty cycles going up to 50,000 pages, these printers are suited for both light and moderate workloads across home and small office environments.
title: Best Laser Printers With Scanners That You Can Buy in India Right Now

description: Nasdaq has partnered with Talos to develop tokenised collateral management solutions across traditional and digital asset markets. The initiative aims to improve capital efficiency and streamline asset movement using blockchain technology. While the move highlights growing institutional interest in tokenisation, challenges around regulation, interoperability, and adoption still remain.
title: Nasdaq Partners With Talos to Expand Tokenised Collateral Management in Digital Asset Markets

description: Samsung is all set to launch new Galaxy A-series smartphones in India this week. While Samsung remains tight-lipped about the exact moniker of the phones, leaks have suggested that the Galaxy A57 5G and Galaxy A37 5G could go official at the event. Leaks have already revealed design, colour options, and key specifications ahead of the debut. Both phones are expected to come with triple rear camera units and Exynos chipsets. Here's a roundup of all details about the Galaxy A57 5G and Galaxy A37 5G.
title: Samsung Galaxy A37 5G, Galaxy A57 5G Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India, Specifications

description: The Life is Strange franchise is gearing up for a new chapter with the upcoming release of Life is Strange: Reunion. The narrative-driven title brings back one of its most beloved duos of the franchise, continuing the story of Max Caulfield and Chloe Price. Developed by Deck Nine Games and published by Square Enix, the upcoming game is positioned as a direct sequel to Life is Strange: Double Exposure.
title: Life is Strange Reunion Roundup: Release Date, Price in India, Platforms, Story and Everything We Know

description: Maya Bimbam explores love, lust, and misunderstandings in a 2000s setting.
title: Maya Bimbam OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Tamil Romantic Drama Film Online?

description: OnePlus 15T has been launched in China as the tech firm’s second model in the existing OnePlus 15 lineup in the country. The handset is set to go on sale in the country soon via the Oppo China online store. The new OnePlus 15 series phone is offered in Healing White Chocolate, Pure Cocoa, and Relaxing Matcha (translated from Chinese) colourways. The handset is equipped with a 7,500mAh Glacier Battery. The phone is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The phone also carries a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: OnePlus 15T Launched With 7,500mAh Battery, Dual 50-Megapixel Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: OnePlus India Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Robin Liu is stepping down from his position “to pursue his personal passions”, a OnePlus India spokesperson informed Gadgets360 in a statement. Liu assumed the position of OnePlus India nearly two years ago, in July 2024. Before this, the executive was heading the Chinese smartphone maker’s North America operations. However, the company has yet to reveal the succession plan for OnePlus India. Hence, it is unclear who will be taking over from the outgoing executive.
title: OnePlus India CEO Robin Liu Steps Down After Nearly Two Years, Company Confirms

description: Polymarket and Kalshi have introduced stricter measures to prevent insider trading and market manipulation. The updates include tighter rules around non-public information and user participation. The move comes as regulators increase scrutiny on prediction markets. While these changes aim to improve transparency and trust, concerns remain around enforcement and regulatory classification of such platforms.
title: Polymarket Tightens Rules on Insider Trading, Kalshi Adds User Bans

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8's possible key specifications revealed in new leak. It is said to come with a battery and charging upgrade over the Galaxy Z Fold 7. The upcoming phone could feature a 6.5-inch cover screen and an 8-inch main display. It could run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset, coupled with up to 16GB RAM and up to 1TB storage. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is tipped to feature a 5,000mAh battery with 45W charging support.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Leaked Specifications Hint at Battery, Charging Upgrades

description: Smartphone makers are expected to increase base storage in 2026 as supply changes and on-device AI requirements reshape device configurations. Rising memory costs had earlier raised concerns about reduced specifications, but brands are instead moving towards higher capacities. Trendforce says the shift is linked to the phase-out of low-capacity memory and growing AI demands. Major companies are adopting 256GB or higher options, while 128GB storage could gradually disappear from mainstream Android smartphones by the end of 2026.
title: Smartphone to Launch With More Storage in 2026 Despite Higher Memory Costs: Report

description: Redmi Note 15 SE (Special Edition) 5G will be launched in India on April 2, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. The upcoming handset is teased to boast a red rear panel and a gold-coloured frame. It might also carry a dual rear camera module, housed inside a squircle-shaped camera module. On top of this, a dedicated microsite for the smartphone is now live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The phone will be the special edition of the Redmi Note 15 5G, which was launched in India in January.
title: Redmi Note 15 SE 5G India Launch Date Announced as Company Reveals Key Features

description: Bitcoin traded near $70,000 on Tuesday, gaining after a temporary easing in geopolitical tensions. However, continued uncertainty and large liquidations kept sentiment cautious. Analysts highlighted resistance near $72,500 and support around $68,000, signalling a range-bound market. Ethereum and select altcoins posted gains, but experts said macro factors remain the key driver for the next move.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $70,000 as Geopolitical Developments Support Crypto Markets

description: Cybersecurity researchers recently warned of a growing threat that targeted older iPhone models. This threat, which was previously linked to targeted attacks, seems to have escalated after a more advanced version of the DarkSword hacking toolkit was leaked online. It is now available on public code-sharing platforms like GitHub, potentially making it significantly easier for threat actors to exploit vulnerabilities in older Apple devices.
title: DarkSword iOS Toolkit Now Public on GitHub, Lowering Barrier for Potential iPhone Exploit

description: Honor 500 Pro and Honor 500 were launched last year with the  Snapdragon 8 Elite SoC. Now Honor appears to be gearing up to launch the Honor 600 Pro and Honor 600.  Design renders of new smartphones have been leaked online alongside a few specifications. They seem to have a new look compared to predecessors, with a redesigned camera bump. They are said to come with 6.57-inch OLED displays and Qualcomm Snapdragon chipsets.
title: Honor 600 Pro, Honor 600 Leaked Renders Point to iPhone 17 Pro-Like Design; Tipped to Get 9,000mAh Battery

description: iQOO Z11 is confirmed to be launched in China with the octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 chipset, the Vivo sub-brand announced on Tuesday. The SoC will be paired with iQOO’s next-generation “Monster Over-Core” gaming engine. Moreover, the tech firm claims that the handset managed to score 2,625,016 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform. The upcoming iQOO Z11 will be equipped with a 6.76-inch LCD touchscreen, delivering up to 165Hz refresh rate. The display is claimed to have received TÜV Rheinland Low-Blue Light and Eye-Protection certifications.
title: iQOO Z11 Chipset, Display and Other Key Features Revealed a Day Before Its Launch in China

description: OnePlus Nord 6 will launch in India on April 7 at 7pm IST. The smartphone will be powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset and is claimed to deliver sustained 165 FPS gaming in titles like BGMI, Call of Duty Mobile, and Free Fire MAX. The handset will sport a 165Hz 1.5K AMOLED display with up to 3,600 nits peak brightness and 3,840Hz PWM dimming rate. It is confirmed to pack a 9,000mAh battery with 80W fast charging and bypass charging support.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 India Launch Date, Amazon Availability Confirmed; Colour Options, Key Features Revealed

description: Oura Ring 5 has appeared in a new leak that offers an early look at its design and features. According to a recent report, the smart ring may arrive with subtle design changes, including a more curved outer surface, and new colour options such as Deep Rose, matte black, silver, and gold. The company is expected to retain its current charging system and similar battery life, while focusing on improved sensors and enhanced health tracking. Based on Oura’s release cycle, the Ring 5 is likely to launch in late 2027.
title: Oura Ring 5 Design, Colours Options Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Launch in 2027

description: Redmi Note 16 series is tipped to be equipped with a 10,000mAh battery, according to a report. If this is true, then the purported lineup could launch with a significantly larger battery than the flagship Redmi Note 15 Pro+, which is backed by a 6,500mAh battery. However, it might feature a 200-megapixel primary camera on the back, which is the same as the Note 15 Pro+. Moreover, the Xiaomi sub-brand is expected to keep the charging support unchanged, as the Redmi Note 16 lineup is expected to ship with 100W wired fast charging support.
title: Redmi Note 16 Series Tipped to Launch With Upgraded Battery, Similar Camera Hardware as Predecessor

description: Vivo T5x 5G is now up for sale in India through the company's India Website and Flipkart in two colour options. The new phone has a starting price tag of Rs. 18,999. It features a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset and a 7,200mAh battery with 44W fast charging support. It has a 6.67-inch display with up to 120Hz refresh rate. It has a dual rear camera unit and an IP68 and IP69-rated build.
title: Vivo T5x 5G Goes on Sale in India for the First Time: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers

description: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra is confirmed to launch in China and the global markets soon, as the top-of-the-line model in the flagship Find X9 lineup. The company recently announced the launch timeline of the upcoming handset, and a tipster has now leaked the exact date on which it may debut. It is tipped to be introduced in China and the global markets on the same day, while its India launch could happen later.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Tipped to Launch in China, Global Markets on April 20; India Debut Expected Later

description: Apple's C1X network chip has managed to outperform the Qualcomm X80 modem in 19 of 22 analysed markets on various metrics, including latency, according to a report by Ookla, which analyses speedtest results. Similarly, the C1X-equipped iPhone Air managed to also achieve performance parity with the Qualcomm X80 modem, which is found on the flagship iPhone 17 Pro Max. However, Apple's C1X chip still lags behind in terms of upload speed. The C1X network chip is also found on the recently launched iPhone 17e.
title: iPhone Air’s C1X Chip Performs on Par With Qualcomm's Flagship X80 Modem, Ookla Says

description: Vivo is set to launch the X300 Ultra alongside the X300s in China on March 30. Ahead of the debut, a report has revealed key camera details, including a 3 + 2 Zeiss lens setup, a 200-megapixel Sony LYTIA 901 main sensor, and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera with advanced stabilisation. The phone is also said to feature upgraded light intake and imaging technologies. Separately, the handset has appeared on Geekbench with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, 16GB RAM, and Android 16.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Camera Details Leaked as Handset Surfaces on Geekbench Ahead of March 30 Launch

description: Just days ahead of the formal reveal, specifications of the Vivo X300s have leaked online. It is said to come with a 50-megapixel front camera along with IP68 and IP69 ratings. The leak suggests a 7,100mAh battery and a 200-megapixel primary rear camera, which the company already confirmed last week. It is said to come with a metal frame and could support 90W wired fast charging and 40W wireless charging.
title: Vivo X300s Tipped to Launch With 50-Megapixel Selfie Camera, 90W Fast Charging Support

description: Apple will host its latest edition of the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) in June, the company announced on Monday. Continuing the trend of yesteryears, it will be a five-day affair that is expected to begin with a special event keynote by Apple CEO Tim Cook. At WWDC 2026, the Cupertino-based tech giant will spotlight the latest advancements in Apple software, with iOS 27 likely being at the centre of the showcase.
title: Apple Announces WWDC 2026 for June 8; to Showcase Advancements in AI, Software

description: Apple is said to be preparing to bring advertising to its Maps app. According to a seasoned journalist, the move is part of the Cupertino-based tech giant’s broader strategy to generate more revenue from services. While details remain under wraps, it is expected to function similarly to advertising in Google Maps, and this project could be officially announced as early as this month. The move follows the recent introduction of new advertising slots within the App Store.
title: Apple Maps to Soon Feature Ads on iPhone, More Devices As Apple Expands Service Revenue Strategy: Report
